# datachart

> datachart is a Python data visualization package built on matplotlib. It provides simple chart functions (BarChart, LineChart, ScatterChart, Histogram, Heatmap, BoxPlot, ParallelCoords), figure composition via Panel (overlaying charts on shared axes) and Grid (arranging charts in a grid), and a global configuration system with predefined themes.

Install with `pip install datachart`. All charts return a matplotlib Figure. Style is controlled globally via `datachart.config.config` and themes; per-chart overrides go in each chart's `style` parameter.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/): Package overview, installation, and a first example.
- [How-to Guides](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/): Map of the guide sections: charts, composition & utilities, styling.

## Charts

- [Charts overview](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/charts/): The chart functions, their common data format, and how to save figures.
- [Bar Chart](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/charts/barchart/): Bar chart input attributes, single and multiple datasets, customization, and saving.
- [Box Plot](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/charts/boxplot/): Box plot input attributes and customization; multiple datasets require subplots.
- [Heatmap](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/charts/heatmap/): Heatmap input attributes, single and multiple datasets, customization, and saving.
- [Histogram](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/charts/histogram/): Histogram input attributes, single and multiple datasets, and histogram views.
- [Line Chart](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/charts/linechart/): Line chart input attributes, single and multiple datasets, customization, and saving.
- [Parallel Coordinates](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/charts/parallelcoords/): Parallel coordinates input attributes and customization for multivariate data.
- [Scatter Chart](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/charts/scatterchart/): Scatter chart input attributes, single and multiple datasets, customization, and saving.

## Composition & Utilities

- [Composition & utilities overview](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/utility/): Map of Panel, Grid, statistics, and figure saving.
- [Panel](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/utility/panel/): Overlaying multiple charts on one plot with Panel: dual y-axes, z-order, emphasis, and nesting panels.
- [Grid](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/utility/grid/): Arranging multiple charts in a grid layout with Grid, including nested rows and layout specs.
- [Statistics](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/utility/stats/): Statistical utilities for preparing chart data.

## Styling

- [Styling overview](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/styling/): Map of configuration, themes, emphasis, and colormaps.
- [Config](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/styling/config/): Customizing the global style via the config singleton: set_theme, update_config, reset_config.
- [Themes](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/styling/themes/): Applying the predefined themes and creating custom ones.
- [Theme Gallery](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/styling/theme-gallery/): Every predefined theme rendered across the chart types.
- [Highlighting](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/styling/highlighting/): Emphasizing and muting data series with the emphasis option.
- [Colormaps](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/how-to-guides/styling/colormaps/): The colormaps available via the COLORS constant.

## API Reference

- [datachart](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/references/): Top-level module reference.
- [datachart.charts](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/references/charts/): Chart function signatures and parameters.
- [datachart.utils](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/references/utils/): Panel, Grid, and save_figure signatures.
- [datachart.utils.stats](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/references/utils/stats/): Statistical function signatures.
- [datachart.config](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/references/config/): The Config class and the global config instance.
- [datachart.themes](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/references/themes/): The predefined theme dictionaries.
- [datachart.constants](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/references/constants/): Enums and constants (THEME, FIG_SIZE, ORIENTATION, COLORS, ...).
- [datachart.typings](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/references/typings/): TypedDict definitions for chart data and style attributes.
